d: Tiệm Nhà An is opening 5 branches, open 24/7: Binh Thanh and Tan Binh (Ho Chi Minh City), central Da Nang, Hoi An Old Town and Duy Xuyen.

t: Nhà An Bình Thạnh — Chi nhánh 1, Bình Thạnh, TP. Hồ Chí Minh
d: Nhà An Binh Thanh (Binh Thanh, Ho Chi Minh City): A leafy townhouse near Landmark 81, with a lotus-filled front yard and a quiet Deadline Room for office workers and students in Binh Thanh. Open 24/7. Hotline/Zalo 0865 920 041.

t: Nhà An Tân Bình — Chi nhánh 2, Tân Bình, TP. Hồ Chí Minh
d: Nhà An Tan Binh (Tan Binh, Ho Chi Minh City): A tea house with old-Saigon patterned tiles near Tan Son Nhat Airport, serving phin coffee and iced oolong, with a Chatter Courtyard for friends after work. Open 24/7. Hotline/Zalo 0865 920 041.

t: Nhà An Đà Nẵng — Chi nhánh 3, Trung tâm TP. Đà Nẵng
d: Nhà An Da Nang (Central Da Nang): Right in the heart of Da Nang, near the Han River and Dragon Bridge: a breezy balcony, cold-brew oolong and vegetarian mì Quảng for breakfast. Open 24/7. Hotline/Zalo 0865 920 041.

t: Nhà An Hội An — Chi nhánh 4, Phố cổ Hội An
d: Nhà An Hoi An (Hoi An Old Town): A yellow house in the middle of Hoi An Old Town, with lotus tea and floating lanterns in the evening, an áo dài studio with lanterns and crispy vegetarian bánh xèo. Open 24/7. Hotline/Zalo 0865 920 041.

t: Nhà An Duy Xuyên — Chi nhánh 5, Duy Xuyên, TP. Đà Nẵng
d: Nhà An Duy Xuyen (Duy Xuyen, Da Nang City): A garden house by the Thu Bon River, on the way to My Son Sanctuary: rice fields, Ma Chau silk, garden tea and countryside vegetarian meals. Open 24/7. Hotline/Zalo 0865 920 041.

t: Nhà An Sài Gòn — 2 chi nhánh TP.HCM
d: Nhà An Saigon: 2 branches in Ho Chi Minh City, with Saigon-style drinks like oolong bạc xỉu, kumquat salted plum tea and salted cream phin coffee. Coming Soon.
